'''Renew''' was a salvage company that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korad]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The corporation went bankrupt many years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[MT-7T]] once worked for Renew.<ref name="PoG3" />
